places.name: Rynok Square
places.ai_summary: The heart of Lviv, Rynok Square is a UNESCO World Heritage site surrounded by colorful buildings and vibrant cafes.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for a lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Try the local coffee at one of the cafes.

places.name: Lviv High Castle
places.ai_summary: Offering panoramic views of the city, Lviv High Castle is a historic site and a popular spot for photography.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for the hike up.

places.name: Lviv Opera House
places.ai_summary: A stunning architectural masterpiece, the Lviv Opera House hosts world-class performances and offers guided tours of its interiors.

opening_hours.notes: Performance times vary; check the schedule online.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance for popular shows.

places.name: Dominican Church & Monastery
places.ai_summary: A magnificent baroque church with an impressive interior, the Dominican Church is a must-visit for architecture enthusiasts.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special events or services.
